whyThisMatters: These are not just buzzwords. Knowing what phishing, MFA, or ransomware really mean helps you spot the real thing when it shows up in your inbox or on your screen.
rememberThis: You do not need to learn a full glossary. Just learn enough of these words to spot the real thing when it shows up.

discussionPrompts: Ask which term people knew the clue for but forgot the exact word. Gaps in words are worth saying out loud.
Ask if anyone can explain the difference between malware, ransomware, and a trojan without looking at the clues.
Ask which of these terms shows up in their daily work and which ones are just good to know.
facilitatorNotes.commonWrongAnswer: People most often cannot recall PRETEXTING or mix it up with phishing. It is the least common word in the list.
